# The Bento / Creative Technologist

Category: `creative` · Audience: Design engineers, creative developers, and interactive designers · Output: static HTML/CSS/JS

An expressive, asymmetric collection of work, experiments, and small personal details for people who design in code.

An asymmetric 12-column composition: large identity tile, focus/music widgets, visual project gallery, stack tile, career tile, and a vivid connect tile.

| Token | Exact value |
| --- | --- |
| accent | `#5B21B6` |
| background | `#F5F2FF` |

| Heading family | 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |

Text, muted text, and accent contrast against the background / card surface:

| Foreground | Background | Surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text | 15.53:1 | 17.14:1 |
| muted | 6.40:1 | 7.06:1 |
| accent | 8.14:1 | 8.98:1 |

The preset text combinations exceed 4.5:1. Decorative borders are not used to convey essential information. Custom colors need a new contrast check; this palette check alone is not a full WCAG conformance audit.

## Default content and order

Hero → Now → Projects → About → Skills → Experience → Contact

All identities, organizations, metrics, and work below are fictional examples. Links use example.com. The default footer labels them as illustrative; replace them before removing that label in Theme controls.

### 2. Now — A little of right now.

- **On repeat** — A quiet instrumental playlist
  A personal studio note, not a live music feed. Usually something slow enough to leave room for a good idea.

### 4. About — Equal parts sketchbook and source code.

I feel most at home between a design file and a working prototype. My process is hands-on: make something small, put it in front of someone, notice the friction, and make it better.

Outside the studio: film photos, secondhand bookshops, and a growing collection of tiny side projects.
